name: Grotti Cheetah Classic
location: Spotted along Ocean Drive & Starfish Island
desc: The quintessential Vice City icon inspired by the 1980s Ferrari Testarossa. Features classic pop-up headlights, aggressive side strakes, and a mid-mounted engine spotted cruising past neon-lit art deco hotels in official trailer footage.

name: Bravado Buffalo EVX Police Interceptor
location: VCPD Central Precinct & Vice City Metro Patrols
desc: The primary high-speed pursuit cruiser for the Vice City Police Department, based on modern high-output American interceptor platforms. Fitted with heavy steel push-bars, emergency strobe lightbars, and tactical communications equipment as seen in official trailer pursuits.

name: Pegassi Torero XO
location: Downtown Vice City Luxury Hotel District
desc: Modern hypercar inspired by contemporary Italian flagship designs (Lamborghini Countach LPI 800-4). Equipped with active aerodynamics and scissor doors, prominently parked along Vice City's premier luxury nightlife corridors in trailer footage.

name: Bravado Gauntlet Hellfire
desc: Widebody modern American supercharged muscle car inspired by the Dodge Challenger SRT Hellcat. Showcased performing drift maneuvers during midnight street takeovers in official Rockstar trailer sequences.

name: VCPD SWAT Riot Armored Truck
desc: Heavy armored tactical response carrier utilized by Vice City tactical units during major containment incidents. Equipped with reinforced ballistic panels, elevated gunports, and heavy ramming bumpers.

name: Pfister Comet S2 Cabrio
desc: Rear-engine convertible sports car inspired by the modern Porsche 911 Cabriolet. Seen cruising Ocean Drive with the top down as daytime sun reflects off Vice City's coastal waterways.

name: Albany Cavalcade XL Luxury SUV
location: Vice City Suburbs & Starfish Island Traffic
desc: Modern full-size luxury SUV inspired by the Cadillac Escalade. Features an authoritative tall front grille, vertical LED lighting signatures, and spacious interior cabin spotted in suburban and highway trailer footage.

name: Declasse Tulip M-100
desc: The primary classic four-door getaway sedan driven by dual protagonists Lucia and Jason in the official debut trailer. Inspired by 1970s Chevrolet Chevelle Malibu styling with dual bench seating and heavy American steel bodywork.

name: VCPD Predator Patrol Boat
location: Vice City Canals & Port Gellhorn Harbor
desc: High-powered twin-turbine law enforcement watercraft patrolling Vice City's busy maritime shipping channels, coastal waterways, and canal networks as seen in aerial trailer perspectives.

name: Western Sovereign Police Motorcycle
desc: Heavy touring police motorcycle operated by highway patrol officers along the expansive overseas bridges connecting Vice City to the Keys in official trailer sequences.

name: Shitzu Hakuchou Drag
desc: High-performance drag-style street sportbike. While various street sportbikes and tuner cruisers appear in official night gathering scenes, the exact Hakuchou Drag trim remains unconfirmed by Rockstar Games.

name: Sea Sparrow Amphibious Helicopter
desc: Light utility helicopter equipped with amphibious pontoon floats allowing landings on both water surfaces and hard pads, seen flying over the wetlands and coastal beaches in official footage.
